questions.prompt: Deprived of all hope, the citizens surrendered the city to the enemy.
questions.answer: Omnī spē prīvātī, cīvēs urbem hostibus trādidērunt.

questions.prompt: On the third day the exhausted travelers reached the river.
questions.answer: Tertiō diē fessī viātōrēs ad flūmen pervēnērunt.

questions.prompt: This matter must be handled by us with great care and prudence.
questions.answer: Haec rēs magnā cūrā et prūdentiā nōbīs agenda est.

questions.prompt: The general drew up his battle line on the top of the hill.
questions.answer: Dux aciem in summō colle īnstrūxit.

questions.prompt: Her face, worn by grief, revealed her hidden sorrow.
questions.answer: Faciēs eius, dolōre cōnfecta, occultum maerōrem prōdēbat.

questions.prompt: Deceived by the appearance of virtue, many praise wicked men.
questions.answer: Speciē virtūtis dēceptī, multī scelestōs laudant.

questions.prompt: The enemy's battle lines, broken by our cavalry, fled in disorder.
questions.answer: Hostium aciēs, ab equitātū nostrō fractae, incompositae fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: On that very day the consul announced victory to the senate.
questions.answer: Illō ipsō diē cōnsul senātuī victōriam nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: For many days the sailors wandered across the vast sea.
questions.answer: Multōs diēs nautae per vastum mare errāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The length of the day delighted the farmers laboring in the fields.
questions.answer: Longitūdō diēī agricolās in agrīs labōrantēs dēlectābat.

questions.prompt: Day by day the boy's strength grew under his father's care.
questions.answer: In diēs puerī vīrēs paternā cūrā crēscēbant.

questions.prompt: Human affairs are governed by uncertain fortune.
questions.answer: Rēs hūmānae incertā fortūnā reguntur.

questions.prompt: Led by the hope of freedom, the slaves took up arms.
questions.answer: Spē lībertātis ductī, servī arma cēpērunt.

questions.prompt: The queen entrusted the whole matter to a faithful messenger.
questions.answer: Rēgīna tōtam rem fīdēlī nūntiō mandāvit.

questions.prompt: In adverse circumstances a brave man does not lose hope.
questions.answer: In rēbus adversīs vir fortis spem nōn āmittit.

questions.prompt: The statue of the goddess stood in the middle of the temple.
questions.answer: Effigiēs deae in mediō templō stābat.

questions.prompt: Roused by rabid fury, the dog attacked the passersby.
questions.answer: Rabiē incitātus, canis praetereuntēs petīvit.

questions.prompt: The whole series of events was recorded by the diligent historian.
questions.answer: Tōta seriēs rērum ā dīligentī scrīptōre nārrāta est.

questions.prompt: Placing great hope in his own strength, the young man scorned the elders' advice.
questions.answer: Magnam spem in vīribus suīs pōnēns, iuvenis senum cōnsilia sprēvit.

questions.prompt: On the appointed day the ambassadors set out for Rome.
questions.answer: Cōnstitūtō diē lēgātī Rōmam profectī sunt.

questions.prompt: The nature of the matter demanded a swift and bold decision.
questions.answer: Nātūra reī celere et audāx cōnsilium poscēbat.
